description: This file defines the CloudWatchClient class used to interact with Amazon CloudWatch service. It extends AwsClient and includes method annotations for various CloudWatch operations and corresponding async versions.

classes.name: CloudWatchClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon CloudWatch, providing methods for alarm management, metrics, dashboards, and more.

methods.name: deleteAlarms
methods.description: Deletes specified CloudWatch alarms.

methods.name: deleteAnomalyDetector
methods.description: Deletes the specified anomaly detector.

methods.name: deleteDashboards
methods.description: Deletes specified dashboards.

methods.name: deleteInsightRules
methods.description: Deletes insight rules.

methods.name: deleteMetricStream
methods.description: Deletes a metric stream.

methods.name: describeAlarmHistory
methods.description: Describes the history for specified alarms.

methods.name: describeAlarms
methods.description: Describes the specified alarms.

methods.name: describeAlarmsForMetric
methods.description: Describes the alarms for the specified metric.

methods.name: describeAnomalyDetectors
methods.description: Describes the specified anomaly detectors.

methods.name: describeInsightRules
methods.description: Describes the specified insight rules.

methods.name: disableAlarmActions
methods.description: Disables actions for the specified alarms.

methods.name: disableInsightRules
methods.description: Disables the specified insight rules.

methods.name: enableAlarmActions
methods.description: Enables actions for the specified alarms.

methods.name: enableInsightRules
methods.description: Enables the specified insight rules.

methods.name: getDashboard
methods.description: Returns the details of a dashboard.

methods.name: getInsightRuleReport
methods.description: Returns the details for the specified insight rule.

methods.name: getMetricData
methods.description: Returns the metric data for the specified metric math or metrics.

methods.name: getMetricStatistics
methods.description: Returns statistic data for the specified metric.

methods.name: getMetricStream
methods.description: Returns information about a specific metric stream.

methods.name: getMetricWidgetImage
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of a metric graph.

methods.name: listDashboards
methods.description: Returns a list of dashboards.

methods.name: listManagedInsightRules
methods.description: Lists the managed insight rules.

methods.name: listMetricStreams
methods.description: Returns information about the existing metric streams.

methods.name: listMetrics
methods.description: Returns a list of available metrics.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Returns all tags associated with the specified resource.

methods.name: putAnomalyDetector
methods.description: Creates or updates an anomaly detector.

methods.name: putCompositeAlarm
methods.description: Creates or updates a composite alarm.

methods.name: putDashboard
methods.description: Creates a new dashboard or updates an existing one.

methods.name: putInsightRule
methods.description: Creates or updates an insight rule.

methods.name: putManagedInsightRules
methods.description: Creates or updates the specified managed insight rules.

methods.name: putMetricAlarm
methods.description: Creates or updates an alarm.

methods.name: putMetricData
methods.description: Publishes metric data points to Amazon CloudWatch.

methods.name: putMetricStream
methods.description: Creates or updates a metric stream.

methods.name: setAlarmState
methods.description: Temporarily sets the state of an alarm.

methods.name: startMetricStreams
methods.description: Starts metric streams.

methods.name: stopMetricStreams
methods.description: Stops metric streams.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Adds or updates tags for the specified resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from the specified resource.
